card.title: If this happens, I'll do that

body.claim: A plan shaped like 'if X happens, I will do Y' can make you more likely to reach a goal.
body.why: Psychologist Peter Gollwitzer introduced these 'implementation intentions' in 1999. A goal says what you want. An if-then plan adds the when, where and how, linking a future situation to a specific action. Studies show a higher probability of successful goal attainment.

probes.question: An if-then plan links a future ____ to a specific action.
True or false: a goal intention ('I want to reach X') is more specific than an if-then plan.

claims.quote: The concept of implementation intentions was introduced in 1999 by psychologist Peter Gollwitzer .

claims.claim: Studies show higher probability of successful goal attainment (claim, why)
claims.quote: the use of implementation intentions can result in a higher probability of successful goal attainment
claims.note: Page: 'can result in'; card's 'can make you more likely' is hedged correctly.

claims.claim: If-then plan specifies when, where and how; links future situation to specific action (why, probe 1)
claims.quote: It is subordinate to goal intentions as it specifies the when , where and how portions of goal-directed behavior.

claims.claim: Goal intention ('I want to reach X') is less specific than an if-then plan (probe 2 false)
claims.quote: Implementation intentions on the other hand are much more specific and seek to connect a future critical situation
